name: Full Fathom 500
source:
A slowburn dark yuri kinetic novel about a lesbian couple who wake up to discover they are trapped one thousand metres below sea level on the morning of their first anniversary.

Things may appear indistinct out in the open ocean. Perhaps it's best not to look too hard.

[From [url=https://23noko.itch.io/ff500]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部缓慢燃烧的黑暗百合动力学小说，讲述一对女同性恋夫妇在结婚一周年纪念日的早上醒来，发现自己被困在海平面以下一千米处。

在公海中，事物可能显得模糊不清。也许最好不要看得太仔细。

[来自[url=https://23noko.itch.io/ff500]itch.io[/url]]
